Home/Embed the Converter

Embed the STL Scale Converter on your site

Free to use on any maker blog, tutorial page, or community resource. Drop in one <iframe> and your readers get exact slicer percentages for 16 tabletop scales — the same math as the STL Scale Inspector.

Copy-paste embed code

<iframe
  src="https://stlaccess.com/widget/"
  title="STL scale converter by STLACCESS"
  width="100%" height="560"
  style="border:0;border-radius:20px;background:#0a0a0a;max-width:430px"
  loading="lazy">
</iframe>

The widget is self-contained: no cookies, no scripts for your visitors to load, and the math runs in their browser. If the conversion logic ever changes, it updates everywhere automatically.

Live preview

Deep-link presets

Add URL parameters to the src to pre-select scales: src="https://stlaccess.com/widget/?source=28mm&target=32mm&logic=eye" — perfect for a specific tutorial.

One condition

Keep the "Powered by STLACCESS" line visible inside the widget and let it link to stlaccess.com. That's the whole deal — no accounts, no fees.

Privacy

Zero cookies, zero user data, zero uploads. The widget only reports an anonymous pageview count when the page loads — nothing about your visitors leaves their machine.

Questions about a specific embed context? Get in touch. Want the full reference instead of the widget? Use the STLACCESS Scale Standard and the open datasets.

Help me build this properly

Does this actually solve your problem, or not?

I built this to answer one question: what percentage do I type into my slicer. But I don't know if that is where your workflow actually breaks. Tell me what is broken, missing, or just plain useless here. Honest answers, especially negative ones, are worth more to me than anything else you could do on this page.
